channel.title: F1 Lap Times & Gap Chart - Changelog
channel.description: Real site updates for F1 Lap Times & Gap Chart: new features, fixes and season releases.

item.title: "About this site", "About the author" and "Buy me a beer" pages
item.description: New "About this site" page: why it exists, its Atlas F1 origins, and how it's built with the help of generative AI. New "About the author" page, with professional background and contact links. New "Buy me a beer" page, with a casual GitHub Sponsors link and no expectations attached. All three linked from the footer of every page on the site, next to License and Changelog.

item.title: Better text contrast, FIA documents restored
item.description: Muted text contrast (dates, footer, image credits...) improved in light theme, which had been below the accessibility minimum until now. Restored the links to the 2026 Azerbaijan GP's official FIA documents, lost in a manual regeneration after its automatic publication.

item.title: Champions on the main index, live standings on circuit pages
item.description: Cards/table view on the main index (same toggle each season already had), with that year's Drivers' and Constructors' Champion, national flag included. Current Drivers' and Constructors' standings, refreshed, now shown on the page for each circuit still to be raced. Several national flags corrected (teams and drivers), including Sweden's, which was missing entirely. Unified the changelog's own design: automatic entries now use the same format (title and bullets) as the hand-written ones. Built the 2017 Malaysian Grand Prix (round 15), a real gap left uncovered when the 2017-2021 seasons were rebuilt - it wasn't cancelled, it was F1's last-ever Malaysian GP.

item.title: 2017-2021 seasons published
item.description: The 2017-2021 seasons were published automatically once the 2026 Azerbaijan GP was confirmed.

item.title: 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix published
item.description: 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix published automatically after the race, no manual step.

item.title: 2017-2018 Safety Car/VSC and pending code cleanup
item.description: Safety Car and Virtual Safety Car researched and verified for 2017 and 2018 (the last two seasons that needed it), cross-checked against real historical facts from those races. Support code to build the five 2017-2021 seasons (older PDF format parsers, driver/team grids) merged into the repository.

item.title: Daily automatic updates
item.description: The site now updates itself after every Grand Prix, with no manual step, via GitHub Actions. FIA document URLs are now derived automatically for any country already seen on the calendar, instead of registering them by hand round by round.

item.title: Safety Car/VSC precision, analytics and SEO
item.description: Safety Car/VSC windows now use the real instant of each FIA message instead of the classification leader's whole lap - more precise, especially for drivers with a thin margin to the front. Fixed a progressive column misalignment in the lap times table. Google Analytics added, loaded only after accepting an explicit consent banner (GDPR) - nothing loads until accepted. Meta descriptions, Open Graph, sitemap and favicon so the site indexes and shares better.

item.title: Visual consistency and a critical Safety Car/VSC fix
item.description: "Fastest lap" colours and bold styling unified across all 3 views of a race. Critical fix: Safety Car/VSC is now marked by absolute time window, not lap number - the previous method mislabelled laps for lapped drivers. Fixed a real Chrome/Edge rendering bug: the driver column overlapped the table content when scrolling horizontally in very wide tables.

item.title: New 2026 rounds and driver comparison
item.description: Rounds 13-14 of the 2026 season (Italy, Spain) built and published. Comparative lap-time chart between drivers on the lap rankings page, with a full category legend. Links to GitHub, LinkedIn and GitHub Sponsors on the site's front page.

item.title: Pipeline robustness pass
item.description: Robustness review across the whole pipeline, based on an independent external audit - more validations that fail loud and clear instead of silently assuming a known format.

item.title: Safety Car/VSC tracking and a third language
item.description: Safety Car/VSC tracking added to the gap chart, for the whole 2026 season and part of 2024-2025. French added as the site's third language. Category-based crop filters on the lap chart, and red-flag laps excluded from race-pace calculations.

item.title: Initial launch
item.description: Full pipeline and static site published for the 2022-2026 seasons. "Unofficial site" legal disclaimer in the footer of every page. Circuit pages as a placeholder for races not yet run. Alternative table view on the season index.

item.title: First steps (before the first commit)
item.description: First steps of the pipeline: season data extraction and basic race-build orchestration. Initial season and circuit data registration.
